name: Radiance Over Blossoms and Peaks
description:
Combat Action: When your active character is Columbina, equip this card.
After Columbina equips this card, immediately use Eternal Tides once.
While your Columbina with this card equipped is on the field, after the opponent is affected by Lunar-Charged: One of your characters without maximum Energy gains 1 Energy.
After the opponent is affected by Lunar-Bloom: Your active character takes 1 less DMG the next time they take DMG.
After the opponent is affected by Lunar-Crystallize: Automatically play the Moondrift Harmony with the highest Current Elemental Dice Cost from your Hand for free. (Twice per Round)
(You must have Columbina in your deck to add this card to your deck.)
